metadata.description: Official 23blocks platform plugins for Claude Code. One plugin per block.

plugins.name: forms-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Forms Block - forms, surveys, appointments, app forms with scoring, magic links, OTP verification

plugins.name: content-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Content Block - posts, series, comments, tags, categories, user identities with social interactions

plugins.name: files-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Files Block - user files, storage, entity files, access control, delegations, AI-enabled querying

plugins.name: jarvis-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Jarvis Block - AI agents, versioned prompts, BPMN workflows, conversations, digital twins, tools, LLM integrations

plugins.name: auth-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Auth Block - authentication, users, sessions, API keys, organizations, roles, permissions, invitations, teams, OAuth/SSO, audit logs

plugins.name: search-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Search Block - full-text search, entity management, AI-powered vector search, AWS CloudSearch, email templates, multi-tenant companies

plugins.name: assets-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Assets Block - asset management, digital entities, categories, tags, vendors, warehouses, events, audits, operations, alerts, and access control

plugins.name: campaigns-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Campaigns Block - marketing campaigns, media management, landing pages, audience targeting, templates, and campaign performance tracking

plugins.name: company-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Company Block - organizational structure management including departments, teams, positions, and employee assignments

plugins.name: conversations-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Conversations Block - real-time messaging, conversations, groups, notifications, meetings, WebSocket connections, and file sharing

plugins.name: crm-block
plugins.description: 23blocks CRM Block - customer relationship management including accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, meetings, billings, quotes, referrals, and calendar sync

plugins.name: geolocation-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Geolocation Block - location management, addresses, premises, bookings, routes, regions, and geographic hierarchies

plugins.name: onboarding-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Onboarding Block - user onboarding flows, step-by-step journeys, progress tracking, remarketing, and journey reporting

plugins.name: products-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Products Block - product catalog management including products, categories, brands, carts, orders, stock, pricing, reviews, and promotions

plugins.name: rewards-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Rewards Block - loyalty programs, coupons, badges, customer rewards, offer codes, and expiration rules management

plugins.name: sales-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Sales Block - order management, subscriptions, payments, Stripe integration, MercadoPago, flexible orders, vendor payments, and sales reporting

plugins.name: university-block
plugins.description: 23blocks University Block - learning management with courses, subjects, lessons, assignments, tests, coaching, teachers, students, attendance, and calendar

plugins.name: wallet-block
plugins.description: 23blocks Wallet Block - digital wallets, transactions, transfers, OTP authorization, content storage, and webhook integrations
